pairs.difference: A: the grey cone sits darker than the bright yellow field, with a single flat dark ellipse at its base and a pale ring hugging it; rms 0.168 is just over the real range. B: the envelope and photos fall almost wholly into the white group against dark green corners, with white rims on the cards; gap 0.139 is just over the real range. Each misses by a hair and in opposite directions, so value gives no reason to choose.

A: the inflatable sits in the light-middle groups with hue doing most of the separation, thin white sheens along the tubes and a bright spot behind the arch. B: the rock splits into a lit upper half and one big dark lower mass against a mid field, which matches the broad hero shadow on the real glove and camera. All four numbers are in range for both cards, and neither shows a clear generated value habit.

A: very high key. The sand falls into the top white group and the castle shares that value, with only small dark accents in the windows and under the bucket. Mean 0.771 is well over the range and rms 0.118 is under it. B: also bright (0.726), but the dome is a large dark mass, the opening behind the telescope reaches near black, and rms 0.135 is in range.
pairs.fix: Lower the overall brightness of the sand to a warm mid tone, keep pure white only on the sun-facing tower tops, and give the castle a large soft shadow side and a dark shadow pooling under the bucket and in the gate.

pairs.difference: A: the comet is almost entirely in the white and light groups on one flat dark purple field, a pale fringe follows its edge, and the hero has no real shadow side. Gap 0.26 is far above the real maximum of 0.128. B: the red scarf is darker than its cyan swirl, with its deepest accent inside the collar, and every number is in range. This is the lessons' generated habit of a hero brighter than its background with a tight halo.
pairs.fix: Make the ice rock mostly mid-blue with a broad darker blue shadow on its underside, keep white to a few small highlights, remove the pale glow hugging the outline, and lighten the purple background.

pairs.difference: A: the ball is built from big light and mid wedges with a broad dark shadow area on the sand and lower right, close to the real cards' shadow masses. Vignette and gap are in range and mean is at the top edge. B: the glass and ice are bright with white rim lines against a flat dark blue wall, and a pale glow flares near its base. Gap 0.2 is above the real maximum of 0.158.
pairs.fix: Darken the drink and ice to middle tones, keep white only on a few small glints, drop the white outline on the glass, remove the glow at the base, and lighten the blue wall so the glass does not read as light on dark.

pairs.difference: A: the station is a white and light hero with white rims on every solar panel, set on a flat dark field with no shadow side, the same bright-hero separation as the generated gloves, though all numbers are in range. B: a scene running from a white sky to near-black under the car. It has broad real-like dark masses, but rms 0.232 and vignette -0.318 fall outside the range, so the numbers argue against my eye and I hold this weakly.
pairs.fix: Give the station's body a broad mid-grey shadow side, reduce the white edging on the solar panels to thin mid-tone frames, and lift the background from dark navy toward a middle blue.

pairs.difference: A: the bag is a nearly uniform light mass on dark stripes, with soft inner contrast and a gap of 0.212 that stays just in range. B: a black band along the bottom, dark wall corners, a glow under the lamps and pure white rings in the target stack hard contrast across the whole card. Rms 0.179 is above the real maximum of 0.170.
pairs.fix: Lift the black shelf front and wall corners to dark mid tones, soften the lamp glow, and bring the target's white rings down to warm off-white with a gentle shaded side.

pairs.difference: A: a flat card with mid-tone wall stripes and a mid-tone table, bright white bulbs ringed by even halos, and a hero with few deep accents. Rms 0.109 is below the real minimum of 0.120 and mean 0.724 is near the top. B: dark cast shadow around the book, a white page edge against a mid cover, and wide value range at rms 0.147, close to the shadow depth of real cards.
pairs.fix: Remove the round glow rings around the bulbs, deepen the pot's shadow side and the shadow it casts on the table, and add darker accents where the stems meet the pot.

pairs.difference: A: high key. The rocket body is pure white with hardly any shadow side, the sky and grass sit in light-middle groups, and dark is limited to the fins and tower. Mean 0.732 is above the range and rms 0.12 is below it. B: a clear dark mass of hut interior and shadowed stools against a white bar rim, with in-range numbers.
pairs.fix: Shade the rocket with a broad cool mid-grey shadow down one side, keep white only in a narrow lit strip, and lower the sky and grass slightly so the card is less bright overall.

pairs.difference: A: a near-black lower sphere with hot white glints on the gold stand, on a flat light field. It has hard local contrast but sits inside the range at rms 0.163 and gap -0.276. B: balloons in soft mid groups with a white cloud mass below, separated from the sky mainly by hue, at rms 0.112 in range. These are opposite value designs, and each resembles real cards, the camera and the fan respectively.

A: a white parchment on a darker purple and wood setting, gap 0.285 over the range, but mean and rms are in range and the wood holds several middle steps. B: a white scroll on near-black corners and a black table front, with a dome-shaped glow behind it. Gap 0.313 and rms 0.213 are over the range and mean 0.547 is under it, so B breaks more limits and is the harder light-on-black design.
pairs.fix: Lift the black corners and table front to a deep but visible blue, remove the dome of glow behind the scroll, and shade the scroll with broader warm mid tones so it is not almost all white.

pairs.difference: A: a strong dark blue cabinet mass against a mid field with a bright window, and all numbers in range. B: the silver tube sits in the same light-middle groups as the pink wall, with only the cap dark, so the hero is held apart by hue, not value, and the card reads flat. Rms 0.086 is well below the real minimum of 0.114.
pairs.fix: Add a broad dark side to the silver tube, deepen the folds into dark grey creases, and darken the pink wall slightly so the tube stands out in greyscale.

pattern: Generated cards push value in two ways. Some have a hero brighter than its background, mostly in light groups with little broad shadow side and often a tight glow or white rim. Others are high-key and flat, with too few deep accents and the hero separated by hue only. Real cards keep a large dark mass on the hero or under it, and they let the hero sit in the middle tones.
